Try providing different username.' }); } const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10); await db.run('INSERT INTO users (user_name, password) VALUES (?, ?)', user_name, hashedPassword); res.status(200).json({ message: 'User created successfully' }); } catch (error) { res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' }); } }); app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });
